scope_note: Modeled contribution account for the Apple Washoe County campus and its 2024 expansion. The construction base uses only the packet's explicit $163 million construction-cost schedule and excludes the separate $742,071,428 equipment forecast and the broad historical audit capital total. Campus observations and forecasts remain unallocated to the selected building. Same-region construction coefficients transfer only the direct channel from a public Washoe/Storey IMPLAN analysis; no Switch Citadel observation or model input is included. Fiscal evidence remains a source forecast because no same-period recipient-level receipts or marginal public-service costs were verified, so this fragment publishes no net-fiscal value or public-service-cost break-even. County GDP, employment, and wage gaps are descriptive benchmark applications with fit-sensitivity intervals and no causal-design metadata.
